tree.content:
# mdlite A small Python library that converts Markdown to HTML. Handles headings, paragraphs, bold, italic, inline code, links, and flat lists. ## Requirements - Python 3.10 or higher - pytest (for running tests) ## Installation ```bash git clone https://github.com/riya-dev/mdlite.git cd mdlite pip install -r requirements.txt ``` ## Usage ```python from src.mdlite import render html = render("# Hello\n\nThis is **bold** and *italic*.") print(html) #

Hello

#

This is bold and italic.

``` ## Running tests ```bash pytest tests/ ``` All tests must pass before you open a pull request. See CONTRIBUTING.md. ## Supported syntax | Syntax | Output | |---|---| | `# Heading` | `

` | | `**bold**` or `__bold__` | `` | | `*italic*` | `` | | `` `code` `` | `` | | `[text](url)` | `` | | `- item` | `
  • ` | ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening a pull request. ## License MIT

tree.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
tree.content:
# Contributing to mdlite

Thanks for your interest. Follow these rules — PRs that skip any step will be asked to fix before merge.

## Rules

1. **Branch naming:** `fix/<issue-number>-short-description` or `feat/short-description`
2. **Tests required:** every change must include a test. Bug fixes must have a test that fails on the old code and passes after your fix.
3. **Black formatting:** run `black src/ tests/` before committing. CI will fail if formatting is wrong.
4. **CI must pass:** all tests and the formatter check run on every PR. Do not open a PR with a red CI.
5. **Fill in the PR checklist:** the pull request template has a short checklist. Complete every item.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
pip install black
```

## Opening an issue first

If you want to fix something not already in the tracker, open an issue first and wait for a response.
